context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 16 features fully implemented and tested. UserHeaderMenu in header top-right shows user name and company, dropdown has 'Suspender Minha Agenda' and 'Sair' options. AgendaPage is a new menu item under OPERACIONAL with appointment list, status filters (Hoje/Pendentes/Confirmados/Concluidos/Todos), and action buttons (Confirmar for pendente, Concluir for confirmado, Cancel X for active). Conclude modal has 4 payment methods. CalendarPageFull has 3 views: Mes (month grid), Semana (week timeline), Dia (day hour-by-hour). FinanceiroPage has filter bar with date range, professional select, payment method select. All in Portuguese.

UserHeaderMenu.suspend_modal: Opens with start_date, end_date, reason inputs

action_buttons.Concluir: Shows for confirmado appointments, opens payment modal

views.Mes: Month grid with appointments on days

filters.date_range: DATA INICIO and DATA FIM date inputs
